option_relations.rationale: Bronchiolitis obliterans is a distinct lung disease not directly related to Lung Cancer.

Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a group of progressive lung diseases, but it is not directly equivalent to or a subtype/supertype of Lung Cancer. While COPD can be a risk factor for lung cancer, it is not a direct relation in the context of this mapping.
Bronchiectasis is a condition where the airways of the lungs become permanently damaged and widened, which is not directly related to Lung Cancer.
Diffuse panbronchiolitis (DPB) is a chronic inflammatory disease of the airways, specifically the bronchioles, and is not directly related to Lung Cancer.
